## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `CLI-SERVE-01` — default port 8000 is held by an unrelated container; the evaluator does not stop processes it did not start.
- `API-ERRORS-04` — fault injection exercised by launching the application through `create_app(..., fault=...)` under uvicorn (documented test-only injection point).
- `E2E-PROGRESS-01` — slow-chat applied through the stand-in control endpoint; run status was `queued` when the stream was opened.
- `WRK-TRIAGE-01` — run `started_at` is the queue time; sequential execution was verified on first-step start versus the other run's `finished_at`.
- `PAR-REGISTRY-03` — the extra `export` command was added to a copy of the Typer registry in-process.
- Items were exercised by an ad hoc driver kept in the scratchpad (not part of the project).
